subject: Vendr portal export: manifest delivery + SIG scoping
messages:
From: Olivia Marks <olivia.marks@brightsidehealth.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightsidehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal export + SIG scope

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough earlier. We scoped Brightside's vendor review and the security team asked if you can provide a one-time export (CSV manifest + sample logs) to accelerate ingestion into our GRC tool. Specifically:

- A Vendr manifest with evidence identifiers and S3 URLs (most recent 90 days)
- One sample S3 access log (anonymized OK)
- Clarify which SIG modules you've completed vs. in-progress for the 'Data Protections' and 'Infrastructure Security' sections

We can take a short SFTP push if that's easier. Also including our internal checklist as an attachment (will send separately) — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Regards,

Olivia Marks
Head of Vendor Risk
Brightside Health

Attachment(s): vendr_manifest_request.txt
From: ava_chen@redwood.com <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Marks <olivia.marks@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal export + SIG scope

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and the offer to jump on a call. We're able to provide the CSV manifest and a sample access log. A couple of quick clarifying items before we generate the export:

- Confirm: manifest should include evidence_id, evidence_type, uploaded_by, upload_date, and a presigned S3 URL (90-day window)?
- Are you OK with a single anonymized S3 key sample (no PII) for the access log? We can redact if needed.
- For SIG: we'll snapshot current status. 'Data Protections' is partially complete (controls mapped, evidence pending); 'Infrastructure Security' is fully documented but a couple of tests are in flight.

If you want to avoid SFTP, we can drop the files into a short-lived presigned bucket and share links via Vendr's secure transfer. Proposed delivery: Friday 2025-05-23 EOD PST.

I'll loop Aditya for the export and Mina for the SIG mapping.

Best,

Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): —
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightsidehealth.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal export + SIG scope

Ava — Friday EOD PST works. For the manifest fields above, yes please include presigned URLs and the metadata columns. We will not store any raw logs with PII; redacted sample is fine.

Also a quick ask: do you have your SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months and the control narrative for encryption-at-rest? If you can deliver those alongside the manifest that will remove a few manual requests from our side.

Thanks,

Samir

- Attached: vendr_export_manifest.csv (3,842 rows), s3_access_log_sample.txt (redacted), SIG_v1_responses.xlsx (snapshot of current SIG answers)
- Delivery method: files uploaded to a short-lived presigned bucket (links below) — will expire in 7 days.
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II bridge letter and encryption control narrative. Those are in legal review; ETA Monday 2025-05-26 EOD PST. If you need an interim summary sooner, we can provide a redacted control summary.

Open items we still need from Brightside:
- Confirm receipt of the three files and that the manifest columns match your ingestion schema (evidence_id, evidence_type, uploaded_by, upload_date, presigned_url)
- Any preference on the SIG cells you'd like populated first (we started with Data Protections)
